en-US.title: Daily Bible : Color by number
en-US.short_description: Color inspiring Bible verses, Jesus & Christian pixel art daily by number.
en-US.full_description:
Experience peaceful daily devotions through creative coloring with Daily Bible: Color by Number! Immerse yourself in the Holy Scriptures, Christian stories, and sacred art transformed into soothing pixel art color-by-number illustrations.

Whether you are looking for a calming moment of prayer, a spiritual daily devotion, or a relaxing creative hobby, Daily Bible brings scripture and faith to life, one pixel at a time.

✝️ A SACRED & FAITH-FILLED COLORING EXPERIENCE
• Holy Bible Verses: Color cherished scriptures and inspirational quotes from Psalms, Proverbs, and the Gospels.
• Jesus Christ & Gospel Stories: Portray the life of Christ, the Nativity, the Cross, the Resurrection, and biblical parables.
• Stained Glass Windows: Create radiant cathedral glass mosaics that shine with divine light and vibrant colors.
• Christian Symbols: Fill intricate crosses, peaceful doves, praying hands, angels, church sanctuaries, and holy bread and wine.
• Bible Heroes & Parables: Noah’s Ark, David and Goliath, Moses, the Good Shepherd, and more.

🎨 HOW TO PLAY
1. Select your favorite Bible-inspired artwork from our daily collection.
2. Follow the numbers in the grid and tap matching colors from the palette.
3. Pinch to zoom in on detailed stained glass patterns and intricate cells.
4. Watch radiant, divine artwork come alive before your eyes!

🌟 KEY FEATURES
• Daily Featured Bible Artwork: Enjoy a fresh spiritual pixel art puzzle every day to inspire your daily walk of faith.
• Devotional Streak Tracking: Build a consistent habit of daily prayer, reflection, and mindful coloring.
• Large Panoramic Murals (Split Art): Challenge yourself with grand, multi-part Christian masterpieces you can complete piece by piece.
• 100% Offline Mode: Color your favorite scriptures anywhere, anytime — no Wi-Fi or internet connection required.
• Peaceful & Mindful Relaxation: Enjoy gentle sound effects and smooth haptic feedback designed to soothe stress and anxiety.
• Easy Sharing: Save your finished Christian artwork and share faith-filled blessings with friends, family, and church communities.
• Free & Family-Friendly: Pure, uplifting, reverent content suitable for all ages — from children to adults and seniors.

🕊️ NOURISH YOUR SOUL EVERY DAY
Take a quiet moment each day to pause, reflect, and meditate on God’s Word. Let the peaceful rhythm of coloring bring calm to your mind and joy to your spirit.

Download Daily Bible: Color by number today and color the Word, one pixel at a time!
